_comment: What a cave-in will not take, however much else it takes (design 5.3).
**A cave-in eats absolutely everything otherwise** (Jonah, 2026-09-11) -- terrain, builds, chests,
obsidian, and bedrock, which leaves a star fissure behind it rather than a hole into the void. So this
is the whole of the fence, and it is a tag so a pack can extend it without touching the jar.
**The star fissures are the load-bearing entry.** They are the guaranteed way out of an Age (7.8 makes
finding one the recovery path for a stranded player), so a collapse that swallowed one would be the
exact inverse of the mercy 5.3 designs for. The rest are technical: blocks a world is built OF rather
than blocks a world is made of, which a hillside coming down has no business rearranging.
